CustomField.description: The campaign name the donor typed into the "other" free-text box on the JCRC donate page, when their intended campaign was not one of the listed options. Such gifts land on the static "Website Donation - Other" Campaign; staff work the "Other Campaign Write-Ins to Review" report and reassign each gift to a real Campaign. This text is KEPT after reassignment as an audit record of the donor's own words. JSI-127 / Jason Ott.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Campaign name the donor typed into the website's "other" box. Kept for audit after the gift is reassigned.
